text:
rachel_sales: Quick ping  Prospect (EuroPay) requires an EU-only POC: tenant pinned to eu-west-1, no cross-border egress even for failover, BYO-KMS (AWS KMS in eu-west-1). Need a short SOW + ballpark delta vs hosted. Can we support? @dan_se @olga_sec

dan_se: Yes. Clarify: hard pin (no failover) confirmed? Also will customer accept EU-hosted telemetry or must metrics be disabled?
achel_sales: Hard pin. Metrics must remain in EU.

olga_sec: OK. BYO-KMS AWS (eu-west-1) acceptable; we'll ask for HSM-backed key. Need to deliver subprocessor list filtered for EU-only and an attestation template.

tom_infra: Plan: provision Dedicated eu-west-1 cluster, tenant_pin policy w/ failover disabled, integrate customer CMK, swap telemetry to EU-only stack. Infra time: 5 business days for initial cluster + 2 days for KMS/networking.

dan_se: Ballpark pricing: Dedicated EU pinned + BYO-KMS + EU-only telemetry ≈ +25-35% over hosted; 12mo commit can shave ~5%. Add monthly reserved minimum. Will draft SOW lines and route_policy example.

infra_bot: Ticket INF-7001 created for Dedicated EU provisioning.

olga_sec: Sec action items: produce attestation + filtered subprocessors. Target EOD.
dan_se: Sales action: I'll post an SOW snippet and sample config here by EOD.

rachel_sales: Great, I'll send to EuroPay and ask for commitment term. Thanks all :thumbsup:
